%WATCHDOG_TIME — Port 5555 is not listening. Mac cannot connect to S24 wirelessly. FIX (USB connected): On Mac run: adb -s RFCX219CHKA tcpip 5555 adb connect 100.123.218.30:5555 FIX (no USB): Reconnect USB cable to Mac first, then run the above. DEBUG: Check /sdcard/stayturgid_watchdog.log Shizuku=%SHIZUKU_CHECK | tcpip_attempt=%TCPIP_RESULT

%WATCHDOG_TIME — Shizuku is not running. Secure settings writes will fail; ADB port won't reopen after reboot. FIX: 1. Open Shizuku app on S24 2. Tap "Start Pairing" button 3. Connect USB to Mac, then on Mac run: adb tcpip 5555 If Shizuku keeps crashing: Settings → Apps → Shizuku → Force Stop, then relaunch. DEBUG: Check /sdcard/stayturgid_watchdog.log Port=%PORT_CHECK | SSHD=%SSHD_CHECK

%WATCHDOG_TIME — Termux sshd is not running. SSH access to S24 unavailable. FIX: Open Termux and run: sshd If Termux:Boot is set up, sshd should restart automatically after reboot. If it's missing, deploy start-adb.sh from the stayturgid repo. DEBUG: Check /sdcard/stayturgid_watchdog.log Port=%PORT_CHECK | Shizuku=%SHIZUKU_CHECK
